Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting video and audio recordings of closed executive session meetings from public inspection and copying.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting video and audio recordings of closedexecutive session meetings from public inspection and copying; andadding a new section to chapter 42.56 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Video and audio recordings of any portion of an executive sessionfrom which the public is excluded pursuant to RCW 42.30.110 are exemptfrom public disclosure under this chapter. A majority of thestatutorily or otherwise legally authorized, voting positions of thegoverning body of the public agency may waive this exemption for anyportion of a recording not made confidential by some other law withoutwaiving this exemption for other recordings.
